title: Architecture V2 gate configuration
description: Shape of scripts/architecture-gate.config.json. The gate validates its configuration against the same rules at startup (see scripts/architecture-gate-config.ts) and fails closed on any unknown key or wrong type: a typo used to disable a whole gate family silently, because the config was only cast to its TypeScript interface and never checked at runtime.

$schema.description: Path to this schema, relative to the config file. Must resolve to an existing file.

comment.description: Human-readable justification for the exception lists. Not consumed by the gate.

v2Packages.description: Packages that must not import @praetor/core at all. Each entry must exist on disk with a src/ directory, otherwise the gate would silently check nothing.

forbiddenCoreImports.description: Forbidden module specifiers. Matching is prefix-aware (a specifier matches when it equals the entry or continues it with '/'), so `@praetor/core-extra` is not caught by `@praetor/core`.

v2ImportExceptions.description: Repo-relative paths of v2 files allowed to import @praetor/core, or a bare basename matched as a path suffix.

path.description: Repo-relative directory holding the API source.

legacyImportExceptions.description: Basenames under api.path that predate the boundary and may still import @praetor/core.

unversionedRouteExceptions.description: Basenames under api.path that register routes but are exempt from the /v1/* versioning rule.

authorityExceptions.description: Repo-relative paths exempt from the in-process-authority rule, or a bare basename matched as a path suffix.
